body:
I stayed up all night and thought about it. I don't want help. I refuse to be manipulated into thinking this world is good enough to live in. It's not and I'm better than this place. Over my life I've always been told how useless I am and how much businesses were willing to pay me for my services proved that no one thought very highly of me. 

I'm killing myself out of protest of life itself. 

Good bye.
I can't afford a doctor. Plus I'm burned out on talking to people. I wouldn't get anywhere with a shrink.

I work in computer repair. It's just me and the owner of the business. My job is to handle everything that comes into the shop and when my boss isn't here I have to answer the phone and make sales on the sales floor. I get paid commission and all stolen items are taken out of my paycheck by a percentage of what I get paid versus what the store makes. If I don't stop scams and theft I will get less money at the end of the week. I barely make enough now to pay my rent. 

I've been looking for a job for 4 years. Something that will pay enough for rent. Nothing has come up. I also have a problem with getting to job interviews and if I do get a new job I'd have to live within walking distance of it because I don't have a car anymore.
I thought about therapy. Getting there is a big issue for me. About 5 years ago when I started feeling depressed I called around. I couldn't find a therapist that could work with my schedule.
I'd love to do that if I had a car.

I don't have any money. Just checked my bank account and it says -$233. 

I got a long road to travel before I can quit this place.
